  team: "KC"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: "bootstrap"
    highlight: null
    self_contained: true
    css: [styles_light_vars.css, styles_base.css]
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: true

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 12,
  fig.height = 7,
  dpi = 150
)

tm <- params$team
team_pal <- team_colors_for(tm, teams, base = palette_light)
theme_set(theme_sharp(colors = team_pal))

bg      <- team_pal$bg
panel   <- team_pal$panel
grid    <- team_pal$grid
text_c  <- team_pal$text
muted   <- team_pal$muted
accent  <- team_pal$accent
accent2 <- team_pal$accent2
green_c <- team_pal$green
red_c   <- team_pal$red

tm_info <- teams |> filter(team_abbr == tm)
```

```{r team-header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Team-branded accent override for page chrome (h2, TOC hover, title border)
cat(glue(
  '<style>:root {{ --accent: {accent}; --accent2: {accent2}; }}</style>\n'
))
cat(glue(
  '<div class="team-header">',
  '<img src="{tm_info$team_logo_espn[1]}" alt="{tm}">',
  '<span class="team-header-name">{tm_info$team_name[1]}</span>',
  '</div>\n\n'
))
cat('[← League Overview](../index.html)\n\n')
```

```{r team-summary, results='asis', fig.height=5}
# ── Sharp-Style Team Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────
tm_off <- reg |> filter(posteam == tm)
tm_def <- reg |> filter(defteam == tm)

off_epa  <- mean(tm_off$epa, na.rm = TRUE)
def_epa  <- mean(tm_def$epa, na.rm = TRUE)
edpr_tm  <- mean(tm_off$pass[tm_off$down %in% c(1,2)] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
sr_off   <- mean(tm_off$success, na.rm = TRUE)
sr_def   <- mean(tm_def$success, na.rm = TRUE)
pass_rt  <- mean(tm_off$pass == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
rush_rt  <- 1 - pass_rt
third_off    <- mean(tm_off$first_down[tm_off$down == 3] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
third_def_tm <- mean(tm_def$first_down[tm_def$down == 3] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

# League ranks
rank_off <- rank(-epa_off$epa_per_play)[epa_off$team == tm]
rank_def <- rank(epa_def$epa_allowed)[epa_def$team == tm]

# Down & distance pass rate
dd <- tm_off |>
  filter(down %in% c(1, 2, 3)) |>
  mutate(
    bucket = case_when(
      ydstogo <= 3  ~ "Short",
      ydstogo <= 7  ~ "Medium",
      ydstogo <= 11 ~ "Standard",
      TRUE          ~ "Long"
    ),
    bucket = factor(bucket, levels = c("Short","Medium","Standard","Long")),
    down_label = paste0(down, c("st","nd","rd")[pmin(down,3)], " Down")
  ) |>
  group_by(down_label, bucket) |>
  summarise(pass_rate = mean(pass == 1), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = bucket, y = pass_rate, fill = pass_rate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(pass_rate, accuracy = 1)),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8, color = text_c, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~down_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = accent2, mid = muted, high = accent,
                       midpoint = 0.5, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(
    title    = glue("{tm} — Pass Rate by Down & Distance"),
    subtitle = glue(
      "Off EPA/play: {round(off_epa,3)} (Rank #{rank_off})  |  ",
      "Def EPA allowed: {round(def_epa,3)} (Rank #{rank_def})  |  ",
      "EDPR: {percent(edpr_tm, accuracy=1)}  |  ",
      "Off SR: {percent(sr_off, accuracy=1)}  |  ",
      "3rd Conv: {percent(third_off, accuracy=1)}"
    ),
    x = "Distance to Go", y = "Pass Rate",
    caption = "Data: nflfastR / nflverse"
  ) +
  theme_sharp(base_size = 10, colors = team_pal)

print(p)

# Draft picks table
if (!is.null(draft_2025)) {
  tm_draft <- draft_2025 |> filter(team == tm)
  if (nrow(tm_draft) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n**2025 Draft Class**\n\n")
    tbl <- tm_draft |>
      gt() |>
      cols_label(round = "Rd", pick = "Pick", position = "Pos", full_name = "Player", college = "College") |>
      cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(round, pick, position)) |>
      cols_align(align = "left",   columns = c(full_name, college)) |>
      gt_color_rows(round,
        palette = c(accent, panel, muted),
        domain  = c(1, 7)
      ) |>
      tab_options(
        table.background.color         = panel,
        column_labels.background.color = grid,
        row.striping.background_color  = bg,
        table.font.color               = text_c,
        table.font.size                = px(11),
        table.width                    = pct(60)
      )
    cat(as_raw_html(tbl, inline_css = TRUE))
  }
}

# Trades table
if (!is.null(trades)) {
  tm_trades <- trades |> filter(to_team == tm | from_team == tm)
  if (nrow(tm_trades) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n**Trades**\n\n")
    hide_receiving <- all(is.na(tm_trades$targets))
    hide_rushing   <- all(is.na(tm_trades$carries))
    tbl <- tm_trades |>
      mutate(direction = if_else(to_team == tm, "IN", "OUT")) |>
      select(direction, player, position, age, from_team, to_team,
             draft_comp, off_snap_pct, route_participation,
             targets, receptions, rec_yards, rec_tds,
             carries, rush_yards, rush_tds) |>
      gt() |>
      cols_label(
        direction          = "",
        player             = "Player",
        position           = "Pos",
        age                = "Age",
        from_team          = "From",
        to_team            = "To",
        draft_comp         = "Draft Comp",
        off_snap_pct       = "Snap%",
        route_participation = "Route%",
        targets            = "Tgt",
        receptions         = "Rec",
        rec_yards          = "RecYds",
        rec_tds            = "RecTD",
        carries            = "Car",
        rush_yards         = "RuYds",
        rush_tds           = "RuTD"
      ) |>
      cols_align(align = "center",
                 columns = c(direction, position, age, from_team, to_team,
                              off_snap_pct, route_participation,
                              targets, receptions, rec_yards, rec_tds,
                              carries, rush_yards, rush_tds)) |>
      cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(player, draft_comp)) |>
      fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") |>
      gt_color_rows(off_snap_pct,
        palette = c(muted, accent),
        domain  = c(0, 100)
      ) |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(color = green_c, weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_body(columns = direction, rows = direction == "IN")
      ) |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(color = red_c, weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_body(columns = direction, rows = direction == "OUT")
      ) |>
      tab_options(
        table.background.color         = panel,
        column_labels.background.color = grid,
        row.striping.background_color  = bg,
        table.font.color               = text_c,
        table.font.size                = px(11),
        table.width                    = pct(85)
      )
    if (hide_receiving) tbl <- tbl |> cols_hide(c(route_participation, targets, receptions, rec_yards, rec_tds))
    if (hide_rushing)   tbl <- tbl |> cols_hide(c(carries, rush_yards, rush_tds))
    cat(as_raw_html(tbl, inline_css = TRUE))
  }
}

# Free Agents table
if (!is.null(free_agents)) {
  tm_fa <- free_agents |> filter(to_team == tm)
  if (nrow(tm_fa) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n**Free Agent Signings**\n\n")
    hide_receiving <- all(is.na(tm_fa$targets))
    hide_rushing   <- all(is.na(tm_fa$carries))
    tbl <- tm_fa |>
      select(player, position, age, from_team,
             contract_years, contract_aav, contract_total,
             off_snap_pct, route_participation,
             targets, receptions, rec_yards, rec_tds,
             carries, rush_yards, rush_tds) |>
      gt() |>
      cols_label(
        player              = "Player",
        position            = "Pos",
        age                 = "Age",
        from_team           = "From",
        contract_years      = "Yrs",
        contract_aav        = "AAV ($M)",
        contract_total      = "Total ($M)",
        off_snap_pct        = "Snap%",
        route_participation = "Route%",
        targets             = "Tgt",
        receptions          = "Rec",
        rec_yards           = "RecYds",
        rec_tds             = "RecTD",
        carries             = "Car",
        rush_yards          = "RuYds",
        rush_tds            = "RuTD"
      ) |>
      cols_align(align = "center",
                 columns = c(position, age, from_team, contract_years,
                              contract_aav, contract_total, off_snap_pct,
                              route_participation, targets, receptions,
                              rec_yards, rec_tds, carries, rush_yards, rush_tds)) |>
      cols_align(align = "left", columns = player) |>
      fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") |>
      fmt_currency(columns = c(contract_aav, contract_total),
                   currency = "USD", decimals = 1, suffixing = FALSE) |>
      gt_color_rows(off_snap_pct,
        palette = c(muted, accent),
        domain  = c(0, 100)
      ) |>
      tab_options(
        table.background.color         = panel,
        column_labels.background.color = grid,
        row.striping.background_color  = bg,
        table.font.color               = text_c,
        table.font.size                = px(11),
        table.width                    = pct(85)
      )
    if (hide_receiving) tbl <- tbl |> cols_hide(c(route_participation, targets, receptions, rec_yards, rec_tds))
    if (hide_rushing)   tbl <- tbl |> cols_hide(c(carries, rush_yards, rush_tds))
    cat(as_raw_html(tbl, inline_css = TRUE))
  }
}
```

```{r schedule-2025, results='asis', eval=exists("season_2025_games") && !is.null(season_2025_games)}
tm_sched <- season_2025_games |>
  filter(team == tm) |>
  arrange(week) |>
  mutate(
    opponent_label = if_else(is_home, paste0("vs ", opponent), paste0("@ ", opponent)),
    score = paste0(team_score, "-", opp_score)
  ) |>
  select(week, gameday, opponent_label, result, score,
         spread, moneyline, total,
         off_epa_play, off_edsr, def_epa_play, def_edsr)

if (nrow(tm_sched) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n## 2025 Season Schedule & Results\n\n")

  w <- sum(tm_sched$result == "W")
  l <- sum(tm_sched$result == "L")
  t <- sum(tm_sched$result == "T")
  record_label <- if (t > 0) glue("{w}-{l}-{t}") else glue("{w}-{l}")

  cat(glue(
    "**Final Record: {record_label}**  |  ",
    "Off EPA/Play: {round(mean(tm_sched$off_epa_play, na.rm = TRUE), 3)}  |  ",
    "Off Early-Down SR: {percent(mean(tm_sched$off_edsr, na.rm = TRUE), accuracy = 1)}  |  ",
    "Def EPA/Play Allowed: {round(mean(tm_sched$def_epa_play, na.rm = TRUE), 3)}  |  ",
    "Def Early-Down SR Allowed: {percent(mean(tm_sched$def_edsr, na.rm = TRUE), accuracy = 1)}"
  ), "\n\n")

  tbl <- tm_sched |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      week           = "Wk",
      gameday        = "Date",
      opponent_label = "Opponent",
      result         = "Result",
      score          = "Score",
      spread         = "Spread",
      moneyline      = "ML",
      total          = "O/U",
      off_epa_play   = "Off EPA/Play",
      off_edsr       = "Off Early-Down SR",
      def_epa_play   = "Def EPA/Play",
      def_edsr       = "Def Early-Down SR"
    ) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(off_epa_play, def_epa_play), decimals = 3) |>
    fmt_percent(columns = c(off_edsr, def_edsr), decimals = 0) |>
    fmt_number(columns = spread, decimals = 1, force_sign = TRUE) |>
    fmt_number(columns = moneyline, decimals = 0, force_sign = TRUE) |>
    fmt_number(columns = total, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") |>
    cols_align(align = "center",
               columns = c(week, gameday, result, score, spread, moneyline, total,
                            off_epa_play, off_edsr, def_epa_play, def_edsr)) |>
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = opponent_label) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = green_c, weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = result, rows = result == "W")
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = red_c, weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = result, rows = result == "L")
    ) |>
    gt_color_rows(off_epa_play, palette = c(accent2, panel, accent),  domain = c(-0.3, 0.3)) |>
    gt_color_rows(def_epa_play, palette = c(accent, panel, accent2),  domain = c(-0.3, 0.3)) |>
    gt_color_rows(spread, palette = c(green_c, panel, red_c), domain = c(-14, 14)) |>
    tab_options(
      table.background.color         = panel,
      column_labels.background.color = grid,
      row.striping.background_color  = bg,
      table.font.color               = text_c,
      table.font.size                = px(11),
      table.width                    = pct(90)
    )
  cat(as_raw_html(tbl, inline_css = TRUE))
}
```

```{r snap-counts, results='asis', eval=exists("snap_summary") && !is.null(snap_summary)}
if (!is.null(snap_summary)) {
  snap_seasons <- c("2022", "2023", "2024")

  snap_wide <- function(pct_col) {
    wide <- snap_summary |>
      filter(team == tm, !is.na(.data[[pct_col]])) |>
      select(player, position, season, pct = all_of(pct_col)) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = pct)
    for (s in snap_seasons) if (!s %in% names(wide)) wide[[s]] <- NA_real_
    wide |>
      filter(pmax(`2022`, `2023`, `2024`, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.25) |>
      arrange(desc(`2024`), desc(`2023`), desc(`2022`)) |>
      select(player, position, all_of(snap_seasons))
  }

  snap_gt <- function(df) {
    df |>
      gt() |>
      cols_label(player = "Player", position = "Pos") |>
      cols_align(align = "left",   columns = player) |>
      cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(position, all_of(snap_seasons))) |>
      fmt_percent(columns = all_of(snap_seasons), decimals = 0) |>
      fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") |>
      tab_options(
        table.background.color         = panel,
        column_labels.background.color = grid,
        row.striping.background_color  = bg,
        table.font.color               = text_c,
        table.font.size                = px(11),
        table.width                    = pct(60)
      )
  }

  cat("\n\n## Snap Counts (2022–2024)\n\n")
  cat("Share of team snaps in games played, ", tm,
      " snaps only. Players with ≥ 25% share in at least one season.\n\n", sep = "")

  off_df <- snap_wide("off_pct")
  if (nrow(off_df) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n**Offense**\n\n")
    cat(as_raw_html(snap_gt(off_df), inline_css = TRUE))
  }

  def_df <- snap_wide("def_pct")
  if (nrow(def_df) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n**Defense**\n\n")
    cat(as_raw_html(snap_gt(def_df), inline_css = TRUE))
  }
}
```
